we have identified a novel class of potent anti tubulin agents with anti vascular and antitumor activities.
a series of novel quinoline indoles were designed and synthesized, which exhibited potent anti tubulin activities against five cancer cells and anti vascular activities in vitro.
a series of isoCA 3 analogs were designed, synthesized and evaluated for their biological activities.

the development of a novel class of quinolineindole analogs, which are potent tubulin polymerization inhibitors and anti tumor agents with potential clinical applications.
the design, synthesis and evaluation of a series of quinoline-indole derivatives as novel anti tubulin agents.
the development of novel isoCA 4 analogs as potential antitubulin agents.

the quinoline indolyl moiety could serve as a promising scaffold to develop potent anti tubulin agents for the treatment of cancers.

the quinoline indolyl derivatives 27c and especially 34b are novel potent anti tubulin agents with potent anti vascular activities, which are promising candidates for further development as anti cancer drugs.

the introduction of quinoline and/or indole moieties into isoCA 4 scaffold can lead to potent anti tubulin and anti tumor agents.
